Vietnamese Beef Curry (Cari Bo)

 
Cari Bo

Hello again!  It feels like an age since my last post, though it was only last week.   My old camera does this dish no favours.

My mum cooks this about once a month when I come over for dinner.  It is called Vietnamese Beef Curry or Cari Bo, beef simmered slowly in a spiced coconut soup with carrots.  I like it with toasted bread dipped into the sauce.

I never asked her for the recipe, so this one comes from another site. 


Vietnamese Beef Curry (Cari Bo) 
http://recipes.example/vietnamese/beef-curry.php


Ingredients

900g / 2 lb stewing beef, cut into 5cm / 2 inch cubes
2 tbsp grated fresh ginger
1 large onion, finely chopped
6 large garlic cloves, finely chopped
3 fresh red chilies, finely chopped
3 tbsp curry powder, preferably Madras
2 tsp turmeric
1 tsp sugar
1/2 tsp ground black pepper
2 tsp salt
3 tbsp peanut or vegetable oil
4 tbsp fish sauce
4 carrots, cut into 2.5cm / 1 inch chunks
2 tbsp cornflour
500ml / 16 fl oz canned unsweetened coconut milk, well stirred

Method :
 
Mix the beef with the ginger, onion, garlic, chilies, spices and half the salt, then leave it to marinate for two hours. Brown it in the hot oil, add hot water and the fish sauce, and simmer it covered for an hour.

Add the carrots and simmer for fifteen minutes more.  Stir the cornflour into the coconut milk, pour it in, and simmer uncovered until the sauce thickens.
